messages:
Sam: Hey @Maria @Devon — PR #22014 is blocked, CI failing on linux-integ-3. Failing test: `tests/integration/test_kv_reconcile.py::test_reconcile_snapshot`. Passes locally for me. Can someone take a quick look?
Maria: On it. Can you paste the failing snippet and the build id?
Sam: Buildkite shows `build 98765`. Failure tail:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 42 but got 43
E       assert items_equal(snapshot_before, snapshot_after)

/app/tests/integration/test_kv_reconcile.py:128 in test_reconcile_snapshot
```
Sam: Noticed it started after I bumped the kv-lock timeout and reordered a couple async flushes. Locally I can't repro with `pytest -k reconcile -n0`.
Devon: Two quick thoughts — (1) this looks timing-sensitive, possible nondet between flush and background compaction; (2) linux shard-3 has seen a small spike in queue wait times this week. Can you trigger a targeted rerun on shard 3? `/rerun --targeted=shard:3`
Sam: Triggered `/rerun targeted 98765 --shard=3` (new build 98766).
buildkite-bot: build 98766 started, queued on pool linux-integ-3 (runner gpu-5).
Maria: If 98766 is green, I'm fine with merging. If it flakes again we should either add a small wait in the test (ugh) or make the assert tolerant and file a follow-up to tighten afterwards. Don't auto-update snapshots unless we confirm determinism.
Pat: I can approve a snapshot update if we confirm it's purely snapshot drift, but prefer rerun twice. If it fails twice in a row, leave a TODO in the PR and mark me for snapshot approval. :thumbsup:
buildkite-bot: build 98766 passed (shard 3). Full pipeline running.
Sam: Thanks — full pipeline turned green a few minutes later. Merging now. Will open a follow-up to add a short fixture sleep + comment about compaction timing to avoid future flakes.
Devon: Thanks for the fast follow-up. Can we add a quick CI metric in the PR description next time (avg queue wait for last 24h)? It helps triage these timing issues.
Sam: Good idea, will add that to our PR template action item.
